q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for **Wednesday, August 26, 2026**. Today is August 25, 2026. This means resolution occurs in **approximately 24 hours**. This is an extremely short timeframe where the outcome is nearly determined.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's **forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release** for revenue. The research indicates:

- NVIDIA issued guidance on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027 of **$91.0 billion ± 2%** ($89.18B - $92.82B)
- Wall Street consensus is **$91.9 billion** (approximately 1% above NVIDIA's midpoint)
- The earnings report happens tomorrow (August 26, 2026)
- Analysts note that **Q3 outlook (forward guidance) may be more impactful than Q2 reported numbers**

This is asking specifically for forward guidance issued in tomorrow's earnings call—meaning guidance for **Q3 FY2027**, not Q2 results.

Given that:
- We are one day away from the announcement
- The company has already provided Q2 guidance ($91.0B)
- Wall Street expects slight beats on Q2 actual results
- Forward guidance (Q3) will be the key focus
- The research notes Q3 guidance will be "more impactful"

The guidance range of 99.5-115.5 billion suggests the question is asking for Q3 FY2027 forward guidance, which would logically be higher than Q2's $91B given NVIDIA's historical growth trajectory.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker than expected demand signals from cloud/AI customers
- Macro headwinds or customer inventory corrections
- More conservative guidance due to competitive pressures or market uncertainty
- Regulatory or export restrictions (China sales restrictions already baked in)
- Guidance miss vs. current expectations

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Strong demand indicators from major cloud customers (MSFT, Google, Meta, AWS)
- Better than expected execution on H200 or next-gen products
- Upside surprises on China sales or approved export revenue
- Market share gains vs. AMD
- Strong forward bookings or customer commitments
- Sequential growth acceleration

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

**From the research provided:**
- Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0 billion ± 2%
- Wall Street consensus for Q2: $91.9 billion
- Historical pattern: NVIDIA typically provides guidance slightly above analyst consensus but below bull case

**No specific historical forward guidance data is provided in the research** for prior quarters' Q+1 guidance patterns. However, typical tech company growth rates and NVIDIA's historical trajectory suggest Q3 guidance could be 5-15% above Q2 actual results.

## Reasoning on the specific range (99.5-115.5B)

The provided range of **99.5-115.5 billion** appears calibrated for Q3 FY2027 forward guidance. This represents:
- Lower bound: ~9.4% growth from Q2 $91B guidance midpoint
- Upper bound: ~27% growth from Q2 $91B guidance midpoint

Given NVIDIA's recent growth rates and the fact that:
1. Strong demand persists in AI/data center
2. We're one day away from the announcement (nearly certain resolution)
3. Wall Street consensus typically sits near the midpoint of likely guidance
4. The research notes forward guidance is expected to be the focus

The distribution should be skewed toward the lower-to-middle portion of the range, with the most likely outcome around **100-110 billion**, reflecting solid but not explosive sequential growth.

**My estimate reflects:**
- Central tendency: ~105 billion (slightly above the lower bound, representing ~15% sequential growth)
- Wide distribution due to inherent uncertainty in guidance calls, even with 24 hours to announcement
- Slight downside skew acknowledging execution risks and macro uncertainty

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to report its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after the U.S. market closes, with results announced around 1:20 p.m. PT (4:20 p.m. ET) and an analyst call at 2 p.m. PT (5 p.m. ET) [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026), [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, projected revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027). This guidance explicitly "is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China" [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027), meaning any approved China sales would be upside [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825). Wall Street consensus, based on approximately 60 analysts, is slightly higher, averaging $91.9 billion for revenue and $2.09 for adjusted EPS [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This consensus is only about 1% above the company's guided midpoint [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825). Analysts are noting that the Q3 outlook (forward guidance) may be more impactful than the Q2 reported numbers [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825).
